summary: Shutterstock filed an 8-K disclosing that the UK Competition and Markets Authority issued its final Phase 2 report on Shutterstock's previously announced merger with Getty Images. The filing provides no deal terms, pricing, or timeline details. The merger was announced earlier and is being reviewed under UK competition law. Board recommendations and advisors were not named in this filing. The structure involves a regulatory clearance process with the CMA. What to watch: the CMA's final decision on the merger and any conditions imposed; the risk-arb spread will depend on the outcome of UK regulatory review and the terms of the original merger agreement.
